CoxeterBruhat.BruhatLe (Hecke.SymmetricCoxeter.permCoxeterSystem n) u w

(Hecke.SymmetricCoxeter.permCoxeterSystem n).length w ≤ N → (∀ (i m : ℕ), rk w i m ≤ rk u i m) → CoxeterBruhat.BruhatLe (Hecke.SymmetricCoxeter.permCoxeterSystem n) u w

CoxeterBruhat.BruhatLe cs (u * cs.simple s) w

theorem QOU.Machinery.BruhatRank.eq_one_of_all_asc {n : ℕ} {w : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))} (h : ∀ (j : Fin n), w j.castSucc < w j.succ) :
w = 1

theorem QOU.Machinery.BruhatRank.eq_one_of_rk_one_le {n : ℕ} {u : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)} (h : ∀ (i m : ℕ), rk 1 i m ≤ rk u i m) :
u = 1

theorem QOU.Machinery.BruhatRank.rk_one {n : ℕ} (i m : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ n) :
rk 1 i m = min i m

theorem QOU.Machinery.BruhatRank.rk_le_min {n : ℕ} (u : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (i m : ℕ) :
rk u i m ≤ min i m

rk (w * Equiv.swap j.castSucc j.succ) i m ≤ rk u i m

rk (w * Equiv.swap j.castSucc j.succ) i m ≤ rk (u * Equiv.swap j.castSucc j.succ) i m

theorem QOU.Machinery.BruhatRank.IncreasingOn.mono_right {n : ℕ} {u : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)} {a b b' : ℕ} (hu : IncreasingOn u a b) (h : b' ≤ b) :
IncreasingOn u a b'

theorem QOU.Machinery.BruhatRank.rk_eq_of_index_ge {n : ℕ} (u : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) {i : ℕ} (h : n ≤ i) (m : ℕ) :
rk u i m = rk u n m

theorem QOU.Machinery.BruhatRank.rk_le_of_endpoints {n : ℕ} (u w : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) {a b i m : ℕ} (hu : IncreasingOn u a b) (hbn : b ≤ n) (hai : a ≤ i) (hib : i ≤ b) (hA : rk w a m ≤ rk u a m) (hB : rk w b m ≤ rk u b m) :
rk w i m ≤ rk u i m

theorem QOU.Machinery.BruhatRank.rk_ge_min_of_increasingOn {n : ℕ} (u : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) {a b : ℕ} (hu : IncreasingOn u a b) (hbn : b ≤ n) (m : ℕ) {i : ℕ} (hai : a ≤ i) (hib : i ≤ b) :
min (rk u b m) (rk u a m + (i - a)) ≤ rk u i m

theorem QOU.Machinery.BruhatRank.rk_eq_add_of_all_lt {n : ℕ} (u : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) {a i m : ℕ} (hai : a ≤ i) (hin : i ≤ n) (hall : ∀ (x : Fin n), a ≤ ↑x → ↑x < i → ↑(u x) < m) :
rk u i m = rk u a m + (i - a)

def QOU.Machinery.BruhatRank.IncreasingOn {n : ℕ} (u : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (a b : ℕ) :
Prop

theorem QOU.Machinery.BruhatRank.rk_le_add_sub {n : ℕ} (u : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (i j m : ℕ) :
rk u j m ≤ rk u i m + (j - i)

theorem QOU.Machinery.BruhatRank.card_filter_val_Ico (n a i : ℕ) (h : i ≤ n) :
{x : Fin n | a ≤ ↑x ∧ ↑x < i}.card = i - a

theorem QOU.Machinery.BruhatRank.rk_mono_index {n : ℕ} (u : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) {i j : ℕ} (h : i ≤ j) (m : ℕ) :
rk u i m ≤ rk u j m

theorem QOU.Machinery.BruhatRank.rk_le_of_bruhatLe {n : ℕ} {u w : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))} (h : CoxeterBruhat.BruhatLe (Hecke.SymmetricCoxeter.permCoxeterSystem n) u w) (i m : ℕ) :
rk w i m ≤ rk u i m

theorem QOU.Machinery.BruhatRank.rk_le_of_sublist {n : ℕ} (ω : List (Fin n)) :
(Hecke.SymmetricCoxeter.permCoxeterSystem n).IsReduced ω → ∀ (ω' : List (Fin n)), ω'.Sublist ω → ∀ (i m : ℕ), rk ((Hecke.SymmetricCoxeter.permCoxeterSystem n).wordProd ω) i m ≤ rk ((Hecke.SymmetricCoxeter.permCoxeterSystem n).wordProd ω') i m

theorem QOU.Machinery.BruhatRank.isReduced_of_isReduced_concat {n : ℕ} {ρ : List (Fin n)} {j : Fin n} (h : (Hecke.SymmetricCoxeter.permCoxeterSystem n).IsReduced (ρ ++ [j])) :
(Hecke.SymmetricCoxeter.permCoxeterSystem n).IsReduced ρ ∧ (Hecke.SymmetricCoxeter.permCoxeterSystem n).length ((Hecke.SymmetricCoxeter.permCoxeterSystem n).wordProd ρ * (Hecke.SymmetricCoxeter.permCoxeterSystem n).simple j) = (Hecke.SymmetricCoxeter.permCoxeterSystem n).length ((Hecke.SymmetricCoxeter.permCoxeterSystem n).wordProd ρ) + 1

theorem QOU.Machinery.BruhatRank.rk_mul_simple_mono {n : ℕ} (u w : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))) (j : Fin n) (hlen : (Hecke.SymmetricCoxeter.permCoxeterSystem n).length (w * (Hecke.SymmetricCoxeter.permCoxeterSystem n).simple j) = (Hecke.SymmetricCoxeter.permCoxeterSystem n).length w + 1) (h : ∀ (i m : ℕ), rk w i m ≤ rk u i m) (i m : ℕ) :
rk (w * (Hecke.SymmetricCoxeter.permCoxeterSystem n).simple j) i m ≤ rk (u * (Hecke.SymmetricCoxeter.permCoxeterSystem n).simple j) i m

theorem QOU.Machinery.BruhatRank.rk_mul_simple_le {n : ℕ} (w : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))) (j : Fin n) (hlen : (Hecke.SymmetricCoxeter.permCoxeterSystem n).length (w * (Hecke.SymmetricCoxeter.permCoxeterSystem n).simple j) = (Hecke.SymmetricCoxeter.permCoxeterSystem n).length w + 1) (i m : ℕ) :
rk (w * (Hecke.SymmetricCoxeter.permCoxeterSystem n).simple j) i m ≤ rk w i m

theorem QOU.Machinery.BruhatRank.permCoxeterSystem_simple' (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) :
(Hecke.SymmetricCoxeter.permCoxeterSystem n).simple i = Equiv.swap i.castSucc i.succ

theorem QOU.Machinery.BruhatRank.rk_mul_swap_mono {n : ℕ} (u w : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))) (j : Fin n) (hasc : ↑(w j.castSucc) < ↑(w j.succ)) (h : ∀ (i m : ℕ), rk w i m ≤ rk u i m) (i m : ℕ) :
rk (w * Equiv.swap j.castSucc j.succ) i m ≤ rk (u * Equiv.swap j.castSucc j.succ) i m

theorem QOU.Machinery.BruhatRank.rk_mul_swap_le {n : ℕ} (w : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))) (j : Fin n) (hasc : ↑(w j.castSucc) < ↑(w j.succ)) (i m : ℕ) :
rk (w * Equiv.swap j.castSucc j.succ) i m ≤ rk w i m

theorem QOU.Machinery.BruhatRank.rk_succ_succ {n : ℕ} (u : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))) (j : Fin n) (m : ℕ) :
rk u (↑j + 2) m = rk u (↑j + 1) m + if ↑(u j.succ) < m then 1 else 0

theorem QOU.Machinery.BruhatRank.rk_castSucc_succ {n : ℕ} (u : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))) (j : Fin n) (m : ℕ) :
rk u (↑j + 1) m = rk u (↑j) m + if ↑(u j.castSucc) < m then 1 else 0

theorem QOU.Machinery.BruhatRank.rk_mul_swap_cut {n : ℕ} (u : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))) (j : Fin n) (m : ℕ) :
rk (u * Equiv.swap j.castSucc j.succ) (↑j + 1) m = rk u (↑j) m + if ↑(u j.succ) < m then 1 else 0

theorem QOU.Machinery.BruhatRank.rk_mul_swap_of_ne {n : ℕ} (u : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))) (j : Fin n) (i m : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ ↑j ∨ ↑j + 2 ≤ i) :
rk (u * Equiv.swap j.castSucc j.succ) i m = rk u i m

theorem QOU.Machinery.BruhatRank.rk_mul_swap_eq {n : ℕ} (u : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))) (j : Fin n) (i m : ℕ) :
rk (u * Equiv.swap j.castSucc j.succ) i m = ∑ y : Fin (n + 1), if ↑((Equiv.swap j.castSucc j.succ) y) < i ∧ ↑(u y) < m then 1 else 0

theorem QOU.Machinery.BruhatRank.rk_zero {n : ℕ} (u : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (m : ℕ) :
rk u 0 m = 0

theorem QOU.Machinery.BruhatRank.rk_succ {n : ℕ} (u : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (i m : ℕ) (hi : i < n) :
rk u (i + 1) m = rk u i m + if ↑(u ⟨i, hi⟩) < m then 1 else 0

theorem QOU.Machinery.BruhatRank.rk_eq_card {n : ℕ} (u : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (i m : ℕ) :
rk u i m = {x : Fin n | ↑x < i ∧ ↑(u x) < m}.card

def QOU.Machinery.BruhatRank.rk {n : ℕ} (u : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (i m : ℕ) :
ℕ
